title: iAstra17's Vision
description: This modpack focuses on improving quality of life and performance in vanilla Minecraft.
body:
![iAstra17's Vision](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f625db2105666faaca513af66221f70d2035067.png)


This modpack elevates the vanilla Minecraft survival experience by focusing on seamless performance, intuitive quality-of-life improvements, and subtle visual enhancements. It streamlines gameplay with smoother navigation, better inventory management, and clearer feedback, while maintaining the authentic vanilla feel. Perfect for players who want a polished and optimized survival adventure without straying from the core game.
